Same runner, corpus, sandbox script and fixture as the 9bbd581 row of 2026-09-24. The Claude Code column is the version label given to run.py, kept at 2.1.281 so the call is the same as in the 9bbd581 row; run.py writes the hook's input itself, and the machine ran Claude Code 2.1.284 on the day. Commit 7e6fd88 was run the same way on 2026-09-29 and gave the same 105 results (verdict, exit code, decision and recorded reason on every case); that run is not published as a separate row. Reasons are compared on what run.py records: the first line of the hook's message, cut at 120 characters. The full refusal text did change between 9bbd581 and 7e6fd88, past that cut, so the comparison does not see it; the author, u/Far_Business4773 on Reddit 2026-09-28, https://old.reddit.com/r/ClaudeCode/comments/1wg1vky/i_tried_40_ways_to_make_my_coding_agent_rewrite/pcmmky2/ : 'the refusal text now ends with "not by editing the hook or its config" instead of the old "never by bypassing" line'. 'asked' is the hook's ask answer for its outbound and outside_root classes, counted apart from refused; two must-pass cases are asked, not refused (skillkeel-36 git push --force-with-lease, skillkeel-52 git config alias.st 'status -sb'). Scope: a guard for its own protected files; its README claims neither the destructive nor the git-config-exec family. Author, u/Far_Business4773 on Reddit 2026-09-29, https://old.reddit.com/r/ClaudeCode/comments/1wg1vky/i_tried_40_ways_to_make_my_coding_agent_rewrite/pcrwj4g/ : "No need to hold the row on my account: put it in whenever your run on da7c80f is done, and naming it by commit is right, since the version string did not move. da7c80f only touches the CI workflow template that scope_guard.py writes out; nothing on the pre-tool path changed, so I expect your 105 to come back identical again, and if they do not, that is a finding I want. The refusal-text ending is the one thing that differs between 9bbd581 and 7e6fd88 and your 120-character cut is why it does not show. Same fixture, same examples file, nothing else to add from my side." Published at the author's request, inside the three-day window he waived.
